description: List facilities that have drawn formal EPA enforcement actions, ranked by total penalties (largest first, then most formal actions). Filter by state, by county (requires state), by program (CAA, CWA, SDWA, or RCRA), or by a minimum total penalty in dollars. Each result shows the facility's name, city, state, ZIP and county, its EPA programs, compliance status, formal and informal action counts, the most recent formal action date, total penalties, penalty count, the most recent penalty date and amount, federal enforcement case count and penalties, and quarters in noncompliance. Results page with limit (default 50, max 500) and offset, and the response reports the total number of matching facilities plus aggregate formal-action and penalty totals across ALL matches, not just the page. Counts and amounts are per-facility rollups as reported in the ECHO Exporter snapshot (see provenance for the file date), not individual enforcement case records; use get_facility for one facility's full profile. SDWA records carry action counts but no penalty amounts in ECHO, so penalty fields are null in SDWA scope and min_penalties cannot be combined with SDWA; TRI and GHG carry no enforcement data and are rejected as the program filter. Use list_facilities_with_violations instead for facilities currently in violation regardless of enforcement history.

min_penalties.description: Only facilities whose total penalties are at least this many dollars

program.description: Program code: CAA, CWA, SDWA, or RCRA (TRI and GHG carry no enforcement data)
